name: segmented-control
summary: Picks one of a few options from a row of items, named by its field, the checked one marked by UI SDK's sliding indicator, which slides to the item chosen: the arrow keys move the choice and pass a disabled item, with read-only and disabled.

notCovered.name: the indicator with no script
notCovered.why: UI SDK places the indicator by measuring the checked item at run time, so with no script it has no box, and the checked item shows by its words alone.

notCovered.name: invalid
notCovered.why: UI SDK's sheet gives a segmented control no invalid look, and no segmented control here sits in an invalid field, so the stage holds no invalid state.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box over each item, 2.75rem tall, so a tap near it reaches it. It draws nothing, so no light reads its size, and the part leaves it as UI SDK sets it.
